publications.title: Waves of Change: Urban resilience pathways to flood and water scarcity risk
publications.description: This report showcases how cities across Europe and Central Asia are tackling floods and water scarcity through integrated urban resilience. It highlights practical case studies, lessons learned, and recommendations to strengthen water resilience.

publications.title: UNDRR Regional Office for Africa Quarterly Newsletter (Apr-Jun 2026)
publications.description: UNDRR's Regional Office for Africa has published its second quarterly newsletter of 2026, detailing the major achievements of the work being done by the organisation.

publications.title: Probabilistic risk assessments to improve impact-based forecasts and strengthen anticipatory action in Latin America and the Caribbean
publications.description: This publication aims to serve as a comprehensive, practical reference on probabilistic risk assessments (PRA) and how they strengthen impact-based forecasting (IBF) and anticipatory action (AA), in support of the Early Warnings for All initiative.

publications.title: Resilience Hubs in Action
publications.description: Resilience Hubs in Action, brings together a selection of good practices shared by Resilience Hubs from the Americas and the Caribbean.

publications.title: Resilient Western Balkans: Strengthening transboundary collaboration and capacities on disaster risk reduction and Early Warning Systems in the Western Balkans
publications.description: The Year 1 narrative report highlights progress in strengthening disaster risk reduction, early warning systems and transboundary cooperation across the Western Balkans.

publications.title: Early Warning Systems for mobile populations: Operational guidance
publications.description: This operational guidance provides direction for designing and implementing people-centred, inclusive multi-hazard early warning systems that effectively reach and protect mobile populations and other groups affected by changing locations or circumstances

publications.title: After-Event Review (AER): Methodological guidance on conducting after-event reviews of Early Warning Systems
publications.description: The AER methodology guidance provides a practical, structured and learning-oriented framework to guide countries and stakeholders in conducting comprehensive and consistent reviews of EWS performance after hazardous events.

publications.title: Leveraging AI to enhance multi-hazard early warning systems
publications.description: This report assesses current applications of AI across all four MHEWS pillars, identifies operational gaps where AI can add value, and outlines the conditions required for responsible and effective implementation of AI.

publications.title: Analytical estimate of damages caused by the June 24, 2026 earthquakes in Venezuela
publications.description: This document constitutes a first estimate of the direct physical damage, obtained through analytical modeling, of the effects caused by the earthquakes of June 24, 2026 in Venezuela.

publications.title: UNDRR ONEA & GETI Newsletter 50: Apr-Jun 2026
